slug: 2025-04-02 Lesotho launches Digital Birth Registration under Ntlafatsa Bana programme

facts.fact: The EU Delegation reports that it, the Government of Lesotho and UNICEF launched the Digital Birth Registration system within the Ntlafatsa Bana programme; deaths are not mentioned (no launch date given; the document's date is used).

The EU Delegation says the Ntlafatsa Bana programme, within which Digital Birth Registration was launched, is supported by UNICEF with an EU contribution; no domestic budget is mentioned (the document's date is used).

systems.owner: Government of Lesotho with the EU Delegation and UNICEF, within the Ntlafatsa Bana programme

note: The document names the system as a birth registration system and says nothing of how or where the record is made; it is classed civil on that description alone. No offices are counted.
